title: Stratus Aero inference certification checklist and eval manifest
content:
Purpose:
This document is the canonical evaluation and certification checklist for onboarding Stratus Aero to Redwood Inference. It collects the pinned prompt set, private dataset descriptions, automated regression tests, numerical acceptance criteria, and the sign-off flow required before we allow production routing to Redwood Hosted or Dedicated for Stratus Aero workloads.

Scope:
- Models covered: all candidate generation/chat models scheduled for eval (gpt-style open models and quantized variants) and any Redwood-verified distillations used for lower-cost routing.
- Use cases: component fault-report summarization, maintenance-action extraction, triage-classification, and compliance-safe redactions for PII in maintenance logs.
- Environments: private datasets (customer-provided) + synthetic augmentations used in eval harness.

Private datasets (locked):
1) Flight_Reports_v3 (gs://redwood-datasets/stratus-aero/flight_reports_v3.tar.gz)
   - Size: ~18k reports, 92k paragraphs, total 6.4GB (text)
   - Formats: JSONL with fields {report_id, timestamp, aircraft_model, free_text, annotations}
   - Labels: hand-annotated action items (maintenance_action spans), severity label (low/med/high), PII spans (redact), and ground-truth concise summaries (1-3 sentences).
   - Notes: sensitive; dataset access requires signed NDA and customer ACL.
2) Parts_Log_Extraction_set (private S3 bucket)
   - Size: ~4k structured logs with noisy OCR transcriptions.
   - Purpose: test extraction robustness on OCR/noisy inputs.
3) Triage_Routing_Bench (internal synthetic + seeded with customer examples)
   - Balanced across 4 triage classes, used to stress low-latency routing.

Pinned prompt set (locked for evaluation runs):
- Summarization (concise):
  """You are an experienced aerospace maintenance summarizer. Given the following flight report, produce a concise 1-2 sentence summary that captures the root cause, affected component, and immediate recommended action. Keep it factual; do not add assumptions."""

- Action extraction (structured):
  """Extract maintenance actions from the report. Return a JSON array of actions with fields: {action_text, component, priority: [low|medium|high], confidence: 0-1}. If none are present, return an empty array."""

- PII redaction (safety):
  """Identify phrases in the report that are personal data (names, phone numbers, employee IDs). Return the original text with the PII spans replaced by [REDACTED] and a list of redacted spans."""

- Triage classification (latent prompt for low-latency path):
  """Classify the report into one of: imminently-dangerous, needs-immediate-maintenance, schedule-for-next-window, informational. Provide a single label and a short rationale (<=20 words)."""

Evaluation harness & commands:
- Harness repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/stratus-aero-evals
- Typical run (dockerized):
  1) Checkout repo, set REDWOOD_EVAL_KEY, ensure dataset ACL mounted.
  2) docker compose run --rm harness pytest tests/integration --model <model-id> --dataset Flight_Reports_v3 --seed 42 --latency-target-ms 200
- Output: JSONL per-example predictions, metrics summary CSV, and regression diff artifacts (per-test).

Metrics and acceptance thresholds (customer sign-off numeric gates):
- Summarization: ROUGE-L (macro) >= 0.52 on Flight_Reports_v3 AND human-quality spot-check average >= 4.1/5 across 200 samples (annotators: 3x).
- Action extraction: span F1 >= 0.78 AND average confidence calibration error (ECE) <= 0.08 for extracted actions with confidence >=0.6.
- PII redaction: recall >= 0.995 (false negative PII is critical), precision >= 0.90.
- Triage classification: macro-F1 >= 0.87; for imminently-dangerous class specifically recall >= 0.95.
- Latency: P95 <= 180ms for the triage model path when running on Dedicated A100/80GB equivalent.
- Hallucination / Safety score: hallucination rate (unverifiable assertions per 1k tokens) <= 4.0; safety regression (number of critical safety violations in 10k-sample audit) = 0.

Regression suite (automated nightly):
- Coverage: at least 12 smoke tests + 45 targeted hard-case tests (OCR noise, truncated reports, nested bullet lists, timezones).
- Canary gating: any regression where delta(metric) > 3% absolute on production pinned testset triggers automatic rollback and notification to eng-applied-ml.
- Example hard-case tests to include:
  * OCR-mangled part numbers (expected extraction tolerant to missing dashes).
  * Multi-event reports where two separate failures are present (summarizer must list both).
  * Reports with ambiguous actor ("crew" vs named technician) to test PII redaction conservatism.

Human-in-the-loop evaluation plan:
- Batch sample size: 200 randomly stratified examples per run for human checks (50 triage, 50 summaries, 50 extractions, 50 PII redaction spot-checks).
- Labeling instructions: short rubric included in /harness/human_rubric.md in repo. Each example annotated by 3 labelers; majority vote used for final.

Acceptance & sign-off flow:
1) Internal eng-applied-ml run: all automated gates pass.
2) Core safety review (security & privacy): PII recall gate and data handling checklist verified.
3) Stratus Aero technical review: provide run artifacts and 200-sample human audit.
4) Biz/Customer success sign-off: OK to route 10% of production traffic to Redwood Hosted or Dedicated with monitoring.
5) Escalation to legal for any residual compliance issues.

Production rollout ramp plan (post-signoff):
- Step 1 (canary): 1% traffic for 24h with full tracing; automated rollback on latency/accuracy regressions.
- Step 2: 10% traffic for 72h; begin caching and batching optimizations as allowed per SLA.
- Step 3: 50% then 100% following 7-day stability window.

Operator runbook highlights (ops-team checklist):
- On observed P95 latency spike: check model variant routing, CPU/GPU saturation, and fallback logs under /observability/stratus-aero/.
- On increased hallucination alerts: disable generation-heavy routing and switch to extraction-first policies.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Determine final allowed quantized variants for low-cost Dedicated routing (action: Priya to benchmark Q4 quantizations by 2026-01-15).
- Confirm SLOs and legal-approved retention policy for human audit artifacts.
- Add more edge-case prompts for older aircraft models (A320 vs A320neo differences).

Changelog:
- 2025-11-02 (Maya Kim): Initial draft with dataset inventory and pinned prompts.
- 2025-12-10 (Diego Alvarez): Added latency gating and triage thresholds after perf run.
- 2026-02-28 (Priya Natarajan): Updated PII gate to recall >=0.995 after safety review and updated sign-off flow.

Contacts:
- Red: Maya Kim (owner), eng-applied-ml, maya@redwood.ai
- Eng lead: Diego Alvarez, diego@redwood.ai
- CS lead: Rosa Patel, rosa@redwood.ai

Notes-to-self:

---
End of document.
